title: Acting primary site safety manager or coordinator.
officialText:
Where the primary site safety manager or coordinator is unable
to be at the site, an alternate site safety manager or coordinator shall act as the primary site safety manager or coordinator. Such
shall be recorded in the site safety log as required by Section 3310.8.4.2, and where required by Section 3310.5.1 notification
shall be provided to the department.
